label: Fragile relief
summary: Markets recovered much of their nerve while the wars kept widening. Nvidia jumped 31.5% after reinstating Jensen Huang, the S&P 500 rose 4.7%, and Seoul and Taipei surged on Tuesday, though that recovers only part of last week's loss and Treasury yields stay near 5%. Iran said three tankers caught fire on mines in Hormuz. Russian strikes killed at least 15 in Ukraine's Kyiv region, Kyiv claimed the sinking of a Russian corvette in Libya, and Moscow accused Estonia of nearing "open war". Fighting in Ituri disrupted an Ebola response with 5,775 recorded deaths. A report found contamination across Gaza, and floodwaters reached record levels in Florida. BepiColombo's arrival at Mercury, a protected Alaskan walrus refuge and Australian online-safety reform offered relief. The weighted formula gave 39; no editorial adjustment.
